scripts.build: pnpm decision:check && pnpm contracts:typecheck && turbo run build
scripts.contracts:coverage: cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --fail-under-lines 90 --fail-under-functions 90 --fail-under-regions 90 && cargo llvm-cov report --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml --lcov --output-path contracts/target/llvm-cov-target/lcov.info
scripts.contracts:lint: cargo fmt --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && pnpm contracts:lint && pnpm repository:check
scripts.test:coverage: turbo run test:coverage && pnpm contracts:coverage && pnpm repository:coverage
